text:
GENERATE BURST K6-male-H1 — male end-game Keeper on the green plate, register H1, for compositing into existing scenes. task_id "K6-male-H1".

Deliver EXACTLY TWO independent candidates of the SAME figure, one image_gen call each. Names: out/k6_male_H1_1.png, out/k6_male_H1_2.png. NO retries: two calls; calls_used must equal 2. NO reference images.

DESCRIPTION (use it verbatim as the content of each call):
Keeper of Hours — ADVANCED (end-game) identity master, male, register H1. THE CHARACTER — Keeper of Hours, ADVANCED (end-game) set, a MAN in his late thirties: weathered sun-browned face, cropped dark beard, dark hair cut short, a scar through one eyebrow, a calm hard-won authority; broad shoulders, a man's proportions. Gear (every item an instrument or carries one): ivory linen shirt under a navy wool tabard, over it a chestnut leather cuirass with brass edge-trim closed at the chest by a BRASS RING bearing a single HOUR-MARK (the Keepers' advanced sigil — the only emblem on him, repeated once as the staff head); a hooded navy wool mantle thrown back; heavy chestnut leather bracers with brass studs; a chestnut harness strap from the right shoulder to the LEFT hip carrying an olive waxed-canvas satchel with brass corners and a brass-capped ledger case; chestnut belt with a brass buckle; navy trousers; chestnut boots with brass-buckled greaves. Staff: dark walnut shaft, brass ferrule at the foot, and at the head a BRASS RING with an hour-mark cradling a small hour-glass crystal that gives off a faint COLD blue-white glow — the only spell light in the scene. One full-body figure, facing the camera (direction S), projection C (elevated three-quarter), standing in a ready stance, weight even, feet visible, staff planted upright in the RIGHT hand. Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside the line, restrained texture; the line carries the pose. It should look like one frame of hand-drawn animation, not a rendered illustration. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on the key-facing edge; the staff crystal's faint cold glow is the only spell light; NO floor shadow. Flat uniform pure #00ff00 background covering the whole canvas; do not matte.

Copy each output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ with the exact names above and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K6-male-H1"): images = the two files with prompt, references (none), elapsed_s; calls_used = 2; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.
